extracted.name: Vegan Mashed Potatoes
extracted.description: Learn how to make vegan mashed potatoes by boiling russets with thyme, rosemary, and plenty of garlic, then mixing with olive oil for a creamy side.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place potatoes, garlic, rosemary, and thyme into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are easily pierced with a knife, about 30 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup cooking water.
Transfer boiled potatoes and garlic to a large bowl; discard rosemary and thyme. Add olive oil, salt, and pepper. Mash with a potato masher, adding cooking water to reach desired consistency.
